beats.label: GRIND_비트(london_grind_3070, uuid=7b899ec2…)
beats.genre: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences
beats.sp: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a constant four-on-the-floor pulse at 130 BPM in the key of F minor. A resonant, syncopated synth bassline with a short decay follows the kick. High-frequency metallic percussion hits on the off-beats, layered with a sharp, white-noise snare on beats two and four. A dark, filtered sawtooth synth lead plays a repetitive, chromatic three-note motif. Periodic industrial sound effects including metallic clangs and mechanical whirs are processed with short room reverb and bitcrushing. The arrangement features sudden low-pass filter sweeps on the master bus and rhythmic gating on the synth pads.

beats.label: Machine_Drill_비트(machine_drill_3070, uuid=f4e9caed…)
beats.sp: Industrial techno track at 135 BPM in the key of D minor. The arrangement is centered around a distorted, saturated kick drum with a heavy sub-bass tail that creates a continuous low-end rumble. A metallic, percussive synth sequence plays a repetitive sixteenth-note pattern with high-pass filter automation. A sharp, white-noise-heavy snare hits on the backbeat, layered with a gritty, industrial clap. A syncopated hi-hat pattern featuring open hats on the off-beats provides rhythmic drive. Distorted, atmospheric drones and mechanical sound effects are panned wide, creating a dense, claustrophobic soundstage. The track features frequent use of bit-crushing and overdrive on the percussion elements. A resonant, acid-style synth lead enters periodically with a short decay and high resonance, performing a minimalist two-note motif.
